items.title: IICE at IISF 2022 Start-Up Conclave
items.description: IICE showcased campus-born technologies and incubated startups at the India International Science Festival (IISF) Start-Up Conclave in Bhopal (21–24 January 2023).

items.title: Startup Studio: Lab to Market
items.description: Launched the Startup Studio series with KIIT-TBI to guide IISER Bhopal researchers and student innovators on converting laboratory results into ventures.

items.title: Sustainable Incubation Dialogue
items.description: Hosted national incubation leaders, including Poyni Bhatt (SINE IIT Bombay), to strengthen deep-tech incubation governance and founder mentorship.

items.title: MSME RAMP Programme Workshops
items.description: Partnered with MP Laghu Udyog Nigam for a two-day World Bank & Ministry of MSME RAMP orientation and incubation exposure programme.

items.title: A-ESDP on Data Science
items.description: A one-week Advanced Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme run with the EECS department and sponsored by the Ministry of MSME.

items.title: Industry–Academia Conclave 2.0
items.description: IISER Bhopal and IICE hosted over 350 delegates on 8 August 2026, where the BIRAC EDGE biotechnology programme was formally announced.
